snippet.title: I Hid a Box Under 1,000,000 Blocks. Can You Find It? | Find the Box Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5208780/Find_The_Box/

Coming November 4.

Find the Box is a relaxing but chaotic, slightly eerie first-person digging game. Can you find it inside a cube of 1,000,000 blocks. Upgrade your build or play with just punches.

When you break through, you will know.

#FindTheBox #mininggame #indiegame #steam #speedrun
